newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa launches freighter flights to Azerbaijan.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa launches freighter flights to Azerbaijan.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG has launched a weekly freighter service from Frankfurt to the Azerbaijani capital, Baku, to meet fast-growing demand for oil industry-related transport services, a company statement said on Thursday.

The McDonnell Douglas DC-8 freighter service, departing on Mondays, will be able to carry up to 47 tonnes of cargo and will boost capacity provided by the twice-weekly Airbus A320/A321 passenger services of parent company, Deutsche Lufthansa AG, it added.
Lufthansa Cargo said it expected a continual rise in cargo volumes to Azerbaijan over the coming years.
"Until the end of 1997, a tonnage of 3,000 tonnes per year is estimated, and then 5,000 tonnes per year is forecast until 2002," the statement said.

"The oil business in the Azerbaijani market which we started serving in 1995 is developing rapidly. For example, oil drilling and production in the northern part of the Caspian Sea will be started in the second half of 1997."
Lufthansa Cargo expects imports into Baku to originate primarily in the USA, Britain, Norway, the Gulf region and Asia, it said.
Azerbaijan officials announced on August 7 that half-year crude oil and gas output rose to 5.36 million tonnes from 4.66 million tonnes in January-June 1995.

Oil industry multinationals which have announced investment or contracts in Azerbaijan in recent months include Exxon Corp, Ramco Oil & Gas Ltd and Finland's Aker Rauma Offshore. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
